acceptance: packages/context-handoff/README.md states that handoff bypass --write persists a signed one-shot grant file at .adlc/handoffs/<session>.bypass-grant.json with TTL BYPASS_GRANT_TTL_MS and that context-handoff-bypass is audit-only (#607).

packages/init/README.md clarifies that .gitignore whole-directory .adlc ignores are normalized to .adlc/* and documents --harness, --no-codex-agents, and .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml (#667).
packages/preflight/README.md clarifies that cleanup is best-effort and that .adlc/tmp/ and .worktrees/ parent directories remain in place (#713).
description: Update packages/context-handoff/README.md to document signed one-shot bypass grants and audit-only manifest entries (#607), update packages/init/README.md to document .gitignore normalization, --harness, --no-codex-agents, and Copilot workflow writes (#667), and update packages/preflight/README.md to describe best-effort cleanup and retained parent directories (#713).
title: docs(context-handoff,init,preflight): align README contracts with implementation (#607, #667, #713)
